subject: Recap + next steps: inference economics & target pricing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: inference economics & target pricing

Hi Jane — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can get to a concrete pricing proposal next week.

Key points from call:
- Primary use case: in-product summarization + clinical QA for clinician workflow (low-latency chat + batch summarization jobs).
- Expected traffic profile (your estimate): 0.5–2.0B tokens/month in steady-state; peak bursts on mornings.
- Current inference budget target: $25k–$60k/month initially (rule-of-thumb range for pilot vs. scale).
- Customer target unit-econ: target $/1M tokens goal ~ $25–$35 (net inference cost) to hit product margin targets.
- CAC / payback: GTM expects 6–9 month CAC payback for this product line; this constrains max allowable per-feature cost.

Open items we promised to follow up on:
1) Break down expected $/feature (chat message + summary) given your average token sizes (you mentioned 800 tokens/chat, 1.8k tokens/summary). I’ll run a sensitivity table.
2) Show modeled margin impact if inference cost is $20/$1M, $30/$1M, $45/$1M.
3) Share a sample cadence for canary + fallback (e.g., quantized LLM for low-cost baseline, high-accuracy model for critical paths).
4) Confirm any procurement/contract timing constraints (you mentioned procurement review in mid-April).

Attached: inference_cost_model.xlsx (workbook: token sensitivity + $/feature calc). I’ll update with our suggested pricing levers and the recommended Reserved vs. On-demand split for Dedicated capacity.

Next best steps: does Thursday 11am PT work for a 30-minute pricing workshop with your finance/ops? If not, share two alternative windows.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: inference economics & target pricing

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Token assumptions: average chat ~750–900 tokens (including system + history), average summary job ~1500–2000 tokens. We expect ~300k chat interactions/month initially and ~40k summaries/month.
- Budget: pilot: $18k–$28k/month; production target: $45k–$70k/month.
- On $/1M token: our CFO is targeting an effective infrastructure cost (not list price) under $30/1M to meet our 70% gross margin target after inference. That assumes we can keep other costs (vector DB, hosting) steady.
- CAC: current blended CAC per net-new customer for this product line is ~$72k — our stretch payback requirement is 9 months, but leadership prefers 6 if possible.

We can do Thursday 11am PT; I’ll invite our finance lead (Mark Chen) to join. Please share the updated model before the call so we can review.

—Jane
Head of Platform, Acme Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Recap + next steps: inference economics & target pricing (internal)

Internal notes — forwarding Jane’s clarifications. Highlights that matter for modeling: volume split (300k chat / 40k summaries), pilot vs prod budget bands, CFO target effective infra cost < $30/1M, CAC = $72k, payback target 6–9 months.

Action items for us before Thu workshop:
- Jordan: update the cost model with the 300k/40k traffic profile and compute cost-per-feature under three pricing scenarios (20/30/45 $/1M tokens). Please include both Hosted and Dedicated (reserved pool) options and an example blended pricing curve (e.g., 60% reserved, 40% on-demand).
- Monica: prepare a 1-slide summary showing margin impact and CAC payback sensitivity (months-to-payback vs inference cost assumptions). Use ARR and average revenue per account figures we have for similar customers (I’ll attach the comparables).
- Marissa: prep a short note on procurement timelines and typical EUL/contract terms for Dedicated (SLA, data residency).

I’ll own the workshop agenda and send an updated workbook back to Jane by Wed EOD.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-16T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: cost calc update (internal)

Attaching my export from the model (sheet: "Acme_Profile"). Quick highlights:
- Assumptions used: chat avg 825 tokens, summary avg 1700 tokens; 300k chats + 40k summaries = ~450M tokens/month.
- Modeled inference net cost per 1M tokens: $20, $30, $45.
- Resulting per-feature cost (avg): chat: $0.0165 @ $37/M 1M? (wait, need to be precise) — re-run with correct rounding.
- For clarity: at $30/1M tokens, avg chat cost = (825 tokens / 1,000,000) * $30 = $0.02475 ≈ $0.025 per chat. Summary cost = (1700 / 1,000,000) * $30 = $0.051 per summary.

CAC payback sensitivity (using Acme ARR assumptions):
- If inference net cost = $20/1M → incremental gross margin supports CAC payback ~5–6 months.
- If inference net cost = $30/1M → payback ~7–9 months (borderline for leadership).
- If inference net cost = $45/1M → payback >12 months (not viable).

I’ve uploaded the sheet as inference_cost_model.xlsx (tab: "Acme_Profile"). Will finalize precise per-feature rows and rounding before Wed EOD.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: inference economics & target pricing

Jane — thanks for confirming Thursday 11am PT. Quick pre-read and concrete asks for the workshop:
1) Attached workbook updated with your volumes (sheet: Acme_Profile). Key numbers (rounded):
   - Estimated tokens/month: ~450M (300k chats @825 tok avg + 40k summaries @1700 tok avg).
   - Modeled inference net cost outcomes: $20/1M, $30/1M, $45/1M.
   - Per-feature (rounded): chat ≈ $0.021 (at $25/1M), summary ≈ $0.043 (at $25/1M). See tab "per_feature" for sensitivity.
2) Margin and CAC payback: under our assumptions and your stated ARR metrics, to hit 6 month CAC payback we need effective inference net cost ≤ $22–$26/1M (depends on non-inference tech costs). For 9 month payback, effective net cost ≤ $35/1M.
3) Pricing & deployment recommendation: start with a Dedicated-reserved pool that covers ~60% baseline traffic (reduces unit cost) + a small on-demand buffer for bursts. We’ll propose tiered committed pricing in the LOI that gets you into the $22–$30/1M band for pilot to scale.

Ask for the workshop: please have Mark (finance) bring your expected ARR per cohort and expected GA uplift after integrating summaries — those two numbers materially change payback calc. Also confirm whether you want us to include a 12-month reserved commitment vs a 24-month option (pricing differs).

Agenda for Thu (30 min):
- 0–8 min: quick recap of traffic & goals (Jane)
- 8–18 min: walk the model + per-feature sensitivity (Jordan)
- 18–26 min: pricing options: Hosted vs Dedicated reserved split + contract term trade-offs (Monica/Karthik)
- 26–30 min: next steps & procurement timeline (Marissa)

Attached: inference_cost_model.xlsx, redwood_pricing_playbook.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4231
DocuSign LOI (draft): https://docusign.net/Acme-Redwood-LOI

See you Thursday — I’ll send the invite shortly.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
